Just a demo! Let's do some analysis on penguins!

Favorite dataset: palmerpenguins because penguins are so cute!

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

## How many penguins in the dataset for each specie?

```{r}
penguins |>
  count(species)
```

### Body mass by species

```{r}
penguins |>
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = species, y = body_mass_g, fill = species)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Penguin Body Mass by Species", x = "Species", y = "Boday Mass (g)")
```
